description: Guarani da Barragem is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O mapa de demarcação apresenta o limite da Terra Indígena Guarani da Barragem, juntamente com a localização dos municípios e estados, a coordenação regional, superfície e perímetro aproximados, escala, data do mapa, processo administrativo e base cartográfica utilizada. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Guarani da Barragem, Guarani Kaiowá, Demarcação, Terra Indígena, Funai. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
